title: Understanding Polynomial Degree
text: Consider how the degree of a polynomial affects the model's ability to fit the data. A higher degree polynomial can fit more complex patterns, but it might also lead to overfitting.

title: Training vs. Validation Error
text: Think about how training error and validation error behave as the complexity of the model increases. Training error usually decreases with complexity, but validation error might increase after a certain point due to overfitting.

title: Identifying Overfitting
text: Which plot shows a decrease in training error but an increase in validation error as the polynomial degree increases?
